title: The Bloom platform — Writing Lab, Speaking Lab and spaced repetition
meta_description: See inside the student portal: essays marked against all four band descriptors, speaking scored for fluency and pronunciation, and a study plan weighted to your weakest skill.

props.heading: Everything a serious candidate needs, in one place.
props.lead: Your school, your practice, your feedback and your teacher — organised by the part of the exam each thing belongs to.

features.title: The School
features.body: Class notes, printable PDFs, audio drills and video lectures — all filed under Listening Part 4, Writing Task 1 and the thirteen other parts of the exam.

features.title: Writing Lab
features.body: Write under exam timing, get a band per criterion, sentence-level corrections, a model answer and a persistent error bank.

features.title: Speaking Lab
features.body: Parts 1, 2 and 3 with a real preparation timer, recording, and analysis of fluency, filler words, idiomatic range and grammar.

features.title: Vocabulary engine
features.body: 570 band-tagged words across nine essay topics, with six study modes and spaced repetition that schedules itself.

features.title: Grammar Academy
features.body: Twelve lessons — concept, real IELTS examples, then a test — ordered so the errors most common for your first language come first.

features.title: Bloom Tutor
features.body: Knows your level, your target, your weakest skill and every error pattern in your writing — so its advice is specific, never generic.

props.heading: This is what you log into every day.
props.body: Not a video library with a login. A working platform that knows your level, marks your work and decides what you study today.

tabs.title: Your dashboard
tabs.body: Estimated band, days to your test, today's four study blocks and your streak — the first thing you see.

tabs.title: Writing Lab
tabs.body: Submit an essay, get a band on all four criteria, every error corrected and a model answer to compare against.

tabs.title: Speaking Lab
tabs.body: Real cue cards, a one-minute prep timer, recording, then fluency, vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation scored separately.

tabs.title: The School
tabs.body: Class notes, PDFs, audio drills and video lectures, filed under the exact part of the exam they belong to.

tabs.title: Your study plan
tabs.body: Every day to your test date, weighted to your weakest skill, with a mock every Saturday. Tick blocks off as you go.

props.note: Also inside: vocabulary with spaced repetition, twelve grammar lessons, ten mock papers, Bloom Tutor, 1-on-1 booking, progress analytics and your receipts.

props.heading: Find out what band you would get today.
props.body: Twenty-five minutes, six parts, and a real CEFR level at the end of it. Free, and yours whether you enrol or not.
props.address: Prestige Tech Park, Marathahalli, Bengaluru 560103, India
